verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that a named Bot keeps its memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions instead of resetting on every task. Community users independently describe each bot owning its own context and the product as chat plus 'seamless memory.' Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how memory works (what gets remembered, how relevant context is selected and applied), user controls to view, edit, or delete memories, and hands-on detail showing recall in new conversations.
